title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper access control. The flaw impacts the integrity of the system but does not affect confidentiality or availability. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
